t: The Luceco rechargeable LED magnetic work light delivers powerful and versatile illumination for trade professionals. This compact and durable work light, featuring a robust IK07 body and toughened glass diffuser, is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders needing reliable lighting in workshops, garages, or on-site. It provides a bright 750lm output with a cool white colour temperature, ensuring clear visibility. The integrated rechargeable battery offers up to 3 hours of light on high mode and 10 hours on low mode. With a magnetic base, stand, and hanging hook, it offers flexible positioning for any task.
